code:
Job log, every night for a year:  "Backup completed successfully." [checkmark]

A restore test would show:
  Attempt restore -> fails: snapshot missing a dependency
  Attempt restore -> fails: restored data is 6 months stale
  Attempt restore -> succeeds, data verified correct

Only the restore test tells you which one you actually have.
caption: A backup discovered broken only during a real disaster is worse than no backup at all.
